h: Shabbos Purifies the Heart Through the Truth of Yaakov

p: "And purify our heart to serve You in truth":
for that is the word of truth,
"The Torah of truth was in his mouth."
For these seven blessings of Shabbos
קוֹל ה׳ עַל הַמָּיִם (תְּהִלִּים כט, ג)
"The voice of Hashem is upon the waters" (Tehillim 29:3);
and the Torah is likened to water
הוֹי כׇּל צָמֵא לְכוּ לַמַּיִם (יְשַׁעְיָה נה, א)
"Ho, all who are thirsty, go to the water" (Yeshayahu 55:1);
and teshuvah too is likened to water,
and all purifications are through water.
"And purify our heart to serve You in truth":
for in holiness there are levels;
for although all Yisrael are holy
nevertheless there are levels in holiness;
נִקְרָא רַבֵּינוּ הַקָּדוֹשׁ עַל שֵׁם וְכוּלֵּי
that he was like the most profane compared to the holy of holies,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בִּירוּשַׁלְמִי סוֹף פֶּרֶק י דְּגִיטִּין)
(as written in the Yerushalmi, end of chapter 10 of Gittin).
וְכׇל שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ מְעַט מִן הַשֶּׁקֶר
and whatever has in it a little falsehood
"Truth said, Let him not be created," etc.
And through the mitzvah of Shabbos,
דְּאִיתָא בְּזֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב צב, א)
as stated in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 92a),
is like one who keeps the whole Torah,"
has in him a word of truth,
have a share in the World to Come,
to do the will of the Creator, blessed be His Name;
and the subjugation to the kingdoms"
And the leaven in the dough
And he caused to bring in
a little falsehood into the heart of Yisrael,
and he clothed himself in the serpent
to bring in the leaven in the dough;
and likewise the subjugation to the kingdoms is through him.
"the sins of the tam (the wholesome one),
And why is it that they place upon the goat,
that it carry to the wilderness,
"Behold, Esav my brother is a hairy (sa'ir) man";
all the sins of the tam,
of the leaven in the dough
and of the subjugation to the kingdoms.
And it emerges that through Shabbos
"And purify our heart to serve You in truth."
